name: AGENT-REALTIME-NEWS
description: Real-time news alerts with sentiment analysis and portfolio impact scoring. Triggers on breaking news, analyzes relevance to your holdings, and alerts you immediately.

nodes.name: News Webhook Trigger
nodes.description: Receives real-time news from Polygon.io or NewsAPI

parameters.query: INSERT INTO news_alerts (ticker, title, impact, recommendation, risk_level, in_portfolio, analysis, auto_traded, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.ticker }}', '{{ $json.title }}', '{{ $json.impact }}', '{{ $json.recommendation }}', '{{ $json.risk_level }}', {{ $json.in_portfolio }}, '{{ $json.analysis }}', false, NOW())
